_schema.purpose: Places where this port deliberately behaves differently from ScummVM's engines/director, so a comparison harness reports them as expected rather than as failures. Read by tools/oracle_diff.py.

divergence_fields.id: stable slug, referenced from the binding site's comment
divergence_fields.area: which trace stream the difference shows up in (channel | dispatch | property | lingo_exec)
divergence_fields.binding: file:symbol in this repo where the divergent behaviour is implemented
divergence_fields.reference: file:function in reference/scummvm at the pinned revision
divergence_fields.evidence: why the game requires it — cite the game's own scripts, which outrank both the oracle and ScummVM's source
divergence_fields.harness_rule: how tools/oracle_diff.py recognises a trace difference as this divergence

verified_agreement_fields.claim: the divergence that was expected but does not exist
verified_agreement_fields.finding: what reading the reference actually established

verified_agreements.claim: The change's design (Decision 2) asserts that ScummVM resolves a numeric label() by position among all markers, so label(0) would return the movie's first marker and every whereami gate would take a dead branch. It names this as the port's first declared divergence.
verified_agreements.finding: Not a divergence. ScummVM never routes an integer argument through the position-indexed path. b_label pops its argument and branches on type: STRING goes to func_label (which is position-indexed for numbers, but only reachable when the argument is a string, which it never is), while a number goes to func_marker. func_marker(0) returns getCurrentLabelNumber(), the frame number of the last marker at or before the current frame. That is playhead-relative and returns a frame number, which is exactly what the game needs and what this port already does at lingo_host.gd _host_call "label".
evidence: reference/scummvm/lingo/lingo-builtins.cpp:2967 LB::b_label — `if (d.type == STRING) marker = func_label(d); else marker = func_marker(d.asInt());`
reference/scummvm/score.cpp:240 Score::getCurrentLabelNumber — walks _labels keeping the last whose number <= _curFrameNumber

Game side: 54 numeric label() call sites in reference/lingo (all label(0), e.g. NIGHT1/night2/BehaviorScript 83, DAY1/wonder/BehaviorScript 366, AIR1/island2/BehaviorScript 3, HOTEL1/book/BehaviorScript 3), against 648 label("<name>") sites that whereami is compared to. Both spellings must yield a frame number, and they do.
